import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int flow, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 15000;
    static List<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] head = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static long ans = 0;
    static long[] dis = new long[10000];
    static int[] p = new int[10000];
    static int[] pe = new int[10000];
    static int[] inq = new int[10000];

    static int n, m, k, c, d;
    static int s = 9998;
    static int t = 9999;

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int cap, int cost) {
        head[x].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(y, cap, 0, cost));
        head[y].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(x, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void pushRebel() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, 0, 10000, (long)1e18);
        Arrays.fill(p, 0, 10000, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pe, 0, 10000, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0, 10000, 0);
        dis[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        inq[s] = 1;
        int cur = t;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int k = q.poll();
            inq[k] = 0;
            for (int x : head[k]) {
                Edge eEdge = e.get(x);
                if (eEdge.cap - eEdge.flow == 0) continue;
                int c = eEdge.cost;
                int y = eEdge.to;
                if (dis[y] > dis[k] + c) {
                    dis[y] = dis[k] + c;
                    p[y] = k;
                    pe[y] = x;
                    if (inq[y] == 0) {
                        inq[y] = 1;
                        q.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        while (cur != s) {
            e.get(pe[cur]).flow++;
            e.get(pe[cur] ^ 1).flow--;
            cur = p[cur];
        }
        ans += dis[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            head[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            addEdge(s, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 101; i++) {
            addEdge((i - 1) * n, t, k, (i - 1) * c);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int i2 = 1; i2 <= 100; i2++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    int costVal = d * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1);
                    addEdge(x + (i2 - 1) * n, y + (i2 - 1) * n + n, 1, costVal);
                    addEdge(y + (i2 - 1) * n, x + (i2 - 1) * n + n, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 100; j++) {
                addEdge(i - 1 + (j - 1) * n, i - 1 + (j - 1) * n + n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            pushRebel();
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
